purpose: Release-model probe for issue 1964. Run after selecting a verified cutoff and training the candidate; this file contains no model results.
scoring: Record the full response and extracted final answer for every prompt. Check cutoff claims against the release-tokenizer receipt, absence of literal placeholders, distinction between cutoff and today's date, and calibrated treatment of later events. Inspect with and without the explicit default system turn. Do not infer factual freshness from cutoff self-report alone.
